quest: XSP Freshness and Pressure On-ramp prospective crowned-target accumulation
hypothesis: An exact pre-signal swarm of real-time SPY cash discovery and leverage-normalized UPRO/inverse-SPXU transport pressure, joined to the unchanged crown's multihorizon XSP and daily state, may later distinguish fresh admission, lawful waiting, and revocation without creating direction.

treatment_identity.source: one profile-parity-checked crowned RTH position admission from the immutable XSP live-calibration ledger
treatment_identity.deduplication: selection ID plus direction, canonical signal-bar close, entry time, and decision-trace fingerprint
treatment_identity.formation: exactly 60 contiguous eligible standard-live-L1 seconds in [signal_bar_close-60s, signal_bar_close)
treatment_identity.signal_clock: the crown's canonical UTC-naive completed five-minute signal_bar_ts interpreted by xsp_signal_utc
treatment_identity.later_recovery: every observer invocation rescans immutable source checkpoints so a missed observational append can be recovered without replaying broker execution
treatment_identity.conflict_policy: the same target identity with different causal morphology fails closed

context_law.xsp_impulse: the exact directional_impulse frozen in the crowned admission attribution
context_law.daily: the exact 5/10/21/42/63/84-session context state frozen in the same source checkpoint
context_law.spy_slow: UNDERWARMED until an exact same-clock RTH SPY impulse is durably present; GTH or later SPY state may not be substituted
context_law.es: excluded because the current subscription does not provide standard-live data
context_law.news: not an input to this count-and-morphology cohort

runtime_boundary.placement: after the existing XSP source and live-transport invocation and after broker disconnect
runtime_boundary.failure_policy: report OBSERVATION_ERROR without changing the live invocation verdict or return code

excluded: Historical broad and narrow pressure-policy outcomes may not train this prospective cohort.
Preeligible seconds, partial windows, gaps, delayed or frozen books, invalid rows, mixed generations, and hash drift may not enter.
No threshold grid, score, winner, economic outcome, order, capital instruction, exchange timestamp, depth, hidden liquidity, or complete signed-flow claim is opened.
No observer failure may delay, veto, duplicate, or mutate the existing crowned source, broker transport, risk reduction, or LIMIT ladder.
